title: 第13章 你越是这样我越觉得有趣第14章 给他一记断子绝孙脚
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 夜色渐深，水帘洞内。
巡逻的小猴儿们脚步声远远传来，又渐渐消失在通道尽头。
江盼被安置回那间紧邻孙悟空卧室的石室。
她焦躁地在石室内来回踱步，脑子里全是孙悟空那张似笑非笑的脸和那句“或许在我枕头底下哦”
【枕头底下……枕头底下··……】这个地点像魔咒一样在她脑海里盘旋。
【最危险的地方就是最安全的地方?还是他故意设下的陷阱?】
自从傍晚被孙悟空牵着回来，她就没安生过。
那猴子不知安的什么心，明知道牛魔王看她的眼神不对，偏要把她圈在怀里，喝酒时让她喂，吃果子时让她剥的。
尤其是蛟魔王看她的眼神，总带着点探究的笑，鹏魔王更是从头到尾没说过话，可那目光落在她身上时，总让她觉得像被鹰隼盯上了似的。
最让她坐立难安的，还是孙悟空。
他看似闲散的与几个魔王谈笑，尾巴却总在她身后扫来扫去，偶尔还会突然伸手，捏捏她的脸蛋，或是在她耳边低语两句无关紧要的话，吓得她心跳都要停了。
【必须今晚动手。
】江盼咬了咬牙，【再等下去，指不定要被这猴子耍出什么花样。
可一想到孙悟空那身本领，她又泄了气，愁眉苦脸的，【打又打不过，硬抢就是送人头……哎呦，烦死了！
脑子里“叮”
地一声，她猛地拍了下额头。
【我去，把系统这祖宗给忘了！
她赶忙在心中呼喊，【系统在不在，你能不能感应到哪吒的那条裤衩?】
【系统：正在感应·……感应完成。
目标物品（哪吒的裤衩）当前位于：宿主正东方向五米内，具体坐标：孙悟空卧室石榻枕下。
检测到低阶防护禁制。
江盼心脏“咚”
地跳了下，又惊又喜。
【果然在枕头底下！
可“禁制”
两个字像盆冷水浇下来，【有禁制……这可怎么办？】
【系统：可提供一次性无声破禁符’（初级），消耗50能量点。
是否兑换?】
【能量点是啥?】江盼追问，
【系统：宿主每完成一个任务可获得相应能量点，能量点可兑换系统商店道具，例如意大利炮、隐身衣等。
【江盼:那我现在有多少】
content_en:
The night is getting darker, inside the Water Curtain Cave.
The footsteps of the patrolling little monkeys came from afar and gradually disappeared at the end of the passage.
Jiang Pan was placed back in the stone room next to Sun Wukong's bedroom.
She paced back and forth in the stone room anxiously, and her mind was filled with Sun Wukong's half-smiling face and the words "Maybe it's under my pillow."
[Under the pillow... Under the pillow...] This place hovered in her mind like a spell.
[The most dangerous place is the safest place? Or is it a trap he deliberately set?]
Ever since she was led back by Sun Wukong in the evening, she has never been peaceful.
The monkey didn't know what An was thinking. He knew clearly that the Bull Demon King looked at her wrongly, but he wanted to keep her in his arms. He let her feed him when he was drinking, and let her peel fruits when he ate.
Especially the way Demon King Jiao looked at her always had an inquiring smile, and Demon King Peng never said a word from beginning to end, but when his eyes fell on her, she always felt as if she was being stared at by an eagle.
What made her most uneasy was Sun Wukong.
He seemed to be casually chatting and laughing with several demon kings, but his tail was always sweeping behind her. Occasionally, he would suddenly reach out and pinch her cheek, or whisper a few insignificant words in her ear, which scared her heart to stop.
[We must do it tonight.
Jiang Pan gritted his teeth and said, "If you wait any longer, this monkey may play some tricks on you."
But when she thought of Sun Wukong's abilities, she became discouraged again and said with a sad face, "I can't beat him again and again, but if I try hard to fight, I'll get killed... Oops, I'm so annoyed!"
"ding" in my head
With a loud sound, she slapped her forehead suddenly.
[I’m going to forget about the ancestor of the system!
She hurriedly shouted in her heart, "Is the system present? Can you sense Nezha's underpants?"
[System: Sensing... Sensing completed.
The target item (Nezha's underwear) is currently located: within five meters due east of the host, with specific coordinates: under the pillow of the stone couch in Sun Wukong's bedroom.
Low-level protection ban detected.
Jiang Pan's heart "thumps"
The ground jumped, surprised and happy.
[Sure enough, it’s under the pillow!
Can be "banned"
The two words poured down like cold water, "There is a restriction... What should I do?" 】
[System: It can provide a one-time silent forbidden talisman’ (elementary level), which consumes 50 energy points.
Do you want to redeem it?】
[What are energy points?] Jiang Pan asked,
[System: Each time the host completes a task, the host can obtain corresponding energy points. The energy points can be exchanged for props in the system store, such as Italian cannons, invisibility cloaks, etc.
[Jiang Pan: How much do I have now]
